title: 第17章 这小子在玩套路第18章 下狠手
slug: 无敌凡体以剑证道杀穿三千界
lines: “嘿嘿，小子，真是没有想到，你竟然也如此腹黑啊，不过鼎爷我喜欢，打吧打吧，收敛越多的灵石越好。”
就在这时，鼎爷也传来了怪笑声，似乎显得极其兴奋。
“鼎爷，您这就抬举小子了，还不是您教导的好？再说了，我这也是为了我们啊。”
李轩心情也很不错，他看着那些报名的人，眼神放光。
那哪里是人，简直就是白花花的灵石啊。
“第一个，胡腾。”
杨辰也是兴奋的很。
他并没有拖节奏，而是迅速开始点名了起来。
伴随着杨辰的点名，很快，第一名青年就闪身登上了擂台。
这人是炼气境九重修为，在登上擂台的刹那，身上气势便已经狂暴了起来。
事实上，凡是敢报名的，最低也都是练气境九重，那些练气境八重根本就不敢上。
他们也不傻，李轩可是击败过先天境一重的林川，哪怕再弱也肯定不是他们能对付的，上去岂不是白送灵石？
“胡腾，炼气境——”
胡腾盯着李轩，还想自报一下修为和境界，顺便放几句狠话。
然而，李轩却根本没给他机会。
他话音还没有落下，一只硕大的拳头便是已经出现在视线之内。
下一刻。
嘭地一声。
胡腾口鼻喷血，直接被砸了出去。
“下一个。”
李轩轻描淡写的挥了挥手。
他现在只想着快点收割一些灵石回去修炼，最好是能够一举突破到先天境。
哪里有心思听这些人废话啊，那不是浪费时间吗？
第二个被点到名的王宇很快登台，他倒是汲取了胡腾的教训，没敢废话，上台就做出了一副严阵以待的表情。
然而，当李轩的拳头就犹如是闪电般砸来之时，他也只能眼睁睁看着自己被砸飞出去，根本没办法做出任何反应。
“下一个。”
李轩淡漠的声音响起。
这一刻，人群彻底炸开了锅。
“卧槽，你特么偷袭。”
“李轩，你太过分了。”
“这个王八蛋竟然不讲武德，打死他。”
李轩瞥了那些人一眼，“上来就不用自报境界了，直接出手便是，免得浪费大家时间，拖后面人的节奏。”
content_en:
"Hehe, boy, I really didn't expect you to be so evil. But I like Master Ding. Let's fight. The more spiritual stones you can gather, the better."
At this moment, Master Ding also heard a strange laugh, and seemed extremely excited.
"Master Ding, you are promoting this kid, isn't it because of your teachings? Besides, I am doing this for us."
Li Xuan was also in a good mood. His eyes lit up when he looked at those who signed up.
That's not a human being, it's just a white spirit stone.
"The first one, Hu Teng."
Yang Chen was also very excited.
He didn't drag his feet, but quickly started naming names.
Following Yang Chen's roll call, the first young man quickly stepped onto the ring.
This man is at the ninth level of Qi Refining Realm. The moment he stepped onto the ring, his aura became violent.
In fact, anyone who dares to sign up is at least the ninth level of the Qi Training Realm, and those who dare not go to the eighth level of the Qi Training Realm.
They are not stupid either. Li Xuan has defeated Lin Chuan, who is at the first level of the Xiantian realm. No matter how weak he is, he is definitely not something they can deal with. Wouldn't it be a waste of spiritual stones if he goes up?
"Hu Teng, Qi Refining Realm——"
Hu Teng stared at Li Xuan and wanted to report his cultivation and realm, and also said a few cruel words.
However, Li Xuan didn't give him a chance at all.
Before he could finish his words, a huge fist appeared in sight.
The next moment.
There was a bang.
Hu Teng spurted blood from his mouth and nose and was immediately knocked out.
"Next one."
Li Xuan waved his hand lightly.
Now he just wants to harvest some spiritual stones quickly and go back to practice. It is best to break through to the innate realm in one fell swoop.
Why bother listening to these people's nonsense? Isn't that a waste of time?
Wang Yu, who was called out for the second time, quickly took the stage. He learned Hu Teng's lesson and didn't dare to talk nonsense. He showed a prepared expression when he came on stage.
However, when Li Xuan's fist struck like lightning, he could only watch as he was thrown away, unable to react at all.
"Next one."
Li Xuan's indifferent voice sounded.
At this moment, the crowd completely exploded.
"Damn it, you sneak attack."
"Li Xuan, you have gone too far."
"This bastard has no martial ethics, beat him to death."
Li Xuan glanced at those people and said, "There is no need to report your own level when you come up. Just take action directly, so as not to waste everyone's time and delay the pace of those behind you."
